contract:
Write a Python module using PyTorch and Triton that defines fused_residual_rmsnorm(x, residual, weight, epsilon) -> (output, residual_out).
Inputs: x and residual are BF16 tensors shaped (rows, hidden_size) on one CUDA device; weight is a BF16 tensor shaped (hidden_size,); epsilon is a positive float.
Result: residual_out = x + residual. output = residual_out * rsqrt(mean(residual_out * residual_out, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + epsilon) * weight, computed in FP32 and returned as BF16.
Both results are new tensors with the input device and dtype. Inputs must not be modified.
Each row must be computed independently, so a row's bits do not depend on which other rows share the batch.
The GPU work must be done by your own Triton program (@triton.jit). Importing torch is allowed only for tensor allocation and device handling.
runtime_version_note: this integration registers a vLLM IR provider; vLLM IR is deprecated and vLLM 0.34.0 removes its op-priority setting, so any vLLM 0.34 or later pin needs a CustomOp-based integration reviewed and qualified first
